state.description: Upgrade protection on 230kV bus, all 115kV buses, and both 230/115kV auto transformers at Grady. Add adequate monitoring on DC supply. Install a 230kV breaker and associated switches on the high side of Grady 230/115kV auto transformer D.

q.instructions: Is this OpenStreetMap substation the endpoint the filing names?

criteria.true: Same facility: the name matches and the operator, voltage and area are consistent with the project.
